benchmark.coldVsWarmNote: cold = first scan after fixture creation; warm = subsequent scans. Page cache not dropped; fixtures regenerated per run and pre/post runs interleaved identically.
benchmark.command: node /tmp/rec-bench/bench.cjs (REPO_ROOT selects tree; OUT_JSON selects output)

fixtureShapes.large: 4500 files in a-b-c depth-3 tree (0.5-8.5KB deterministic) + 4x1.5MiB under-cap binaries
fixtureShapes.medium: 1500x~2KB in 10 dirs + 200 scope-excluded node_modules files + 3MiB over-cap big.bin (honest partial)

benchmark.harness: electron mock + isolated DB under os.tmpdir(); fs/promises wrappers count syscalls by path class (workspace/blob/db); better-sqlite3 is sync and excluded from syscall counts

bottleneck.cause: recordPath ran assertParentsContained per file: O(depth) lstat+realpath per file, siblings re-validating shared ancestors
bottleneck.fastPathIntact: warm scans read zero file bytes (mtime index works); cost was pure metadata syscalls

method: pristine pre-change git worktree at daffdfe for A/B; working tree never stashed; 2 full runs per side; warm medians over 5 in-run scans

skip identical index DELETE+rewrite via indexRecordsEqual
